summary: Abstract offsetTop/offsetLeft metric is unscaled, relative to offsetParent padding edge or initial containing block, and ignores transforms.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.no_offset_parent: border edge relative to initial containing block
semantics.with_offset_parent: element border edge minus offsetParent padding edge

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: DOM getter delegates to renderer relation with offsetParent
